title: Dream Stay | Golf | Spa | Waterslide | Pickleball
description:
Welcome to your dream vacation rental in Scottsdale, Arizona! Nestled in the heart of the breathtaking Sonoran Desert, this luxurious estate offers everything you need for an unforgettable getaway. The Mountain View Estate offers over 5,100 SF of livable space w/8 bedrooms, a huge waterslide w/water feature, heated pool, spa, custom putting green, an outdoor barbecue, firepit, stunning mountain views,over 2.5 acres of lush desert landscape entertainer’s paradise giving you your own resort-style

 The space 
The Beautiful Resort-Style Grounds
The estate boasts a beautiful waterslide oasis with waterfalls with a heated pool and hot tub, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring or soaking up the Arizona sun. Imagine lounging by the poolside, with plenty of lounge space, sipping a refreshing drink, and taking in the serene desert landscape. Including a built-in state-of-the-art grilling station and outdoor kitchen. What's more, the rooftop patio offers one of the best panoramic views in the valley.
For golf enthusiasts, this property is truly a paradise. Step onto the expansive outdoor putting green, and practice your swing amidst the tranquility of the desert surroundings. Challenge your friends and family to a friendly game of corn-hole, or try out your competition pickleball game custom pickleball court adding an extra dose of excitement to your vacation. If you’re looking for a true desert getaway vacation with your own resort-style backyard then this house won’t disappoint. 

ABOUT: The Luxurious Interior Space
As you enter this luxurious property, you'll be greeted by stunning mountain views that stretch as far as the eye can see. Inside, you'll find a well-appointed kitchen that will delight any culinary enthusiast. The kitchen features sleek counters, providing a modern and stylish space to prepare your favorite meals. Whether you're cooking a gourmet feast or simply brewing your morning coffee, this kitchen has all the amenities you need to make your stay effortless and enjoyable.  Inside this house, you'll discover a great room with towering ceilings and an open concept, perfect for large groups. The main floor houses an expansive living room, dual dining spaces, a fully-equipped kitchen, a laundry room, 8 private bedrooms, 4 of those 8 featuring king-sized beds and ensuite baths, promising a private, homely experience. The primary suite is its own retreat, with a walk-in shower, a Jacuzzi tub, and direct access to the back patio.   

  A large game room awaits, complete with a pool table, ping pong, board games, custom poker table., foosball with a large seating area, with a large pocket slider to allow your amazing outdoor space part of your indoor game time.

Relax on the soft leather lounge by the fire in the spacious living area while you gather around for a movie night on the big screen with access to all your favorite streaming apps.

Cook up breakfast, lunch, and dinner in the gourmet kitchen that comes fully equipped with high-end appliances and all the quality cookware, dinnerware, and utensils you could need. There is a large fridge/freezer, a freestanding oven/cooktop, a built-in microwave, and a dishwasher to take care of all the cleaning up. As well as a secondary fridge if needed. 

Eat together at the stylish dining table set for eight with additional seating up at the breakfast bar or take your meals outside and enjoy dinner alfresco style overlooking the sprawling yard. 

After a day of activities, gather in the spacious living area and engage in friendly competition on the shuffleboard. Laugh, cheer, and create lasting memories as you compete for victory in this entertaining game.

ABOUT: The Amazing Location
Located in North Scottsdale near Troon, you'll find an abundance of nearby attractions, including world-class golf courses, renowned spas, upscale shopping, and fine dining establishments. Immerse yourself in the vibrant arts and culture scene, explore the natural wonders of the surrounding desert, or unwind and rejuvenate in the lap of luxury. This home is located near several championship golf courses including Troon North, Scottsdale National, Rio Verde Golf, TPC, and Grayhawk. As well as several hiking trails close by including Granite Mountain, Toms Thumb, Pinnacle Peak, Fraesfield, Browns Ranch, and many more.

Come experience the perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and excitement at this luxurious Scottsdale estate. Book your stay now and make memories that will last a lifetime.

WHY BOOK WITH US:

- Choosing a host can be just as important as choosing a house. 99% of our reviews across all properties we own are 5 star reviews.

- This property is professionally managed with the same level of attention to detail and all the amenities you would expect from a 5 star resort like The Four Seasons or The Ritz-Carlton.

- We operate all of our properties, we do manage homes for other people. This allows us to have a higher level of quality control to ensure you always get a 5 star experience.

- When you book your reservation you will receive a dedicated guest concierge who will be happy to assist you prior to your arrival. During your stay, your guest concierge will be available during business hours to help assist with any questions or issues that may arise.

- Prior to your arrival, the home will be put through a 100 point inspection checklist to ensure everything is in immaculate condition. The home is meticulously maintained and furnished throughout with high-quality furnishings. Every detail of the home and outdoor area has been planned with your comfort in mind.

- We take great pride in what we do, we always try to go above and beyond to make sure our guests are 100% satisfied. We look forward to making your vacation extra special in every way possible. Thank you for considering this beautiful home and we look forward to hosting you.

CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT:

-Early check -in or late check- out is based on availability with an extra fee associated.

- Upon arrival, You will receive a unique security code that will allow you keyless entry into the property using our smart lock. This way you never have to worry about losing a key and everyone in your party will be able to lock and unlock the door with your smart lock code. Your code will be valid during the duration of your stay and will expire after you check out.

- You will receive simple and easy to follow check-out instructions upon your arrival.

-A rental contract will be provided with the greeter at check-in for you to sign
Before checking into the property we must collect a credit card and photo ID to verify your identity and cover any incidentals 

Guest must provide both the same CC and ID at time of check in.

You are choosing to book our home using a 3rd party website and not booking direct. Airbnb does not share your info with us. When you book, you are agreeing to submit a copy of your photo ID, your email address, and credit card to us after you book. This is standard procedure for professional property managers, just like hotels. Age minimum 26, and no pets or 'service pets are allowed'
Guest max occupancy is 16

As part of our check-in process, we ask that all guests complete our credit card verification form prior to arrival. We understand that you have already provided your credit card information through the third-party booking platform. However, because your reservation was made through a third party, we do not have a way to independently verify that the credit card being used is valid, belongs to the cardholder, and matches the name listed on the reservation.

Due to recent fraudulent activity, we have implemented this additional verification step as a security measure to help protect both our guests and our properties. The verification form requests the full credit card number so that we can confirm the card being used is authorized by the cardholder and associated with the guest making the reservation.

We hope you understand that this process is in place for your best interest as well as ours. Our goal is to help prevent fraudulent activity, protect our guests from unauthorized use of their payment information, and ensure a safe and secure booking process for everyone.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and cooperation with this additional security measure, and we look forward to welcoming you to our property!

- Pool heating is optional and available for additional nightly rate. We do not charge for hot tub
The pool can be heated during winter months when the natural pool temperature drops due to lower outside air temperatures. When heated, the temperature will be maintained the best we can during winter months. As the pools are outside we have them set for the 87 but as the temps drop so do the pools. We do heat them but the colder outside the harder it is to hold higher temps, It is still heated but not in the 80's during the colder seasons. We generally recommend that the pool be heated October 15th through May 31st in order to be a comfortable swimming temperature. To ensure the pool is heated for your arrival we require a minimum 3 day advance notice. If you decide to take advantage of the optional pool/spa heat it is required for the entire duration of your stay, it can not be turned on and off daily.

*If there is an amenity that has an issue during your stay we reserve the right to fix it before you have the ability to cancel or get a refund. If we issue a refund it will be up to a max of 10% off for that night. ** If we are able to fix it there will be no refund applied,. If its out of our control such as ac, water leak, or plumbing issues, we will not offer any refund.

Effective 1/1/2024 a $1000 incidental/ noise deposit will be held upon check in and refunded back to your bank after checkout, when home is inspected and no damages and noise violation occurred. 

THINGS WE OFFER:

- Full Concierge Service

- Transportation Coordination

- Catering and In-Home Chef's

- On-Demand Grocery Delivery

- In-Home Massage

- Additional Kid/Baby Supplies for additional fee 

Experience the Desert with All its Wonders!

During your stay in this beautiful desert oasis, you may encounter some of Arizona's unique wildlife, including scorpions, snakes and desert insects. These creatures are a natural part of the desert environment, and while they typically keep to themselves, it's always a good idea to stay aware of your surroundings. Please note, while the property is regularly treated for pests, we cannot be held responsible for any encounters with desert wildlife, including scorpions or any other desert indoor or outdoor bugs, that may occur during your stay. We recommend taking precautions, such as keeping doors and windows closed when not in use and using caution when stepping outside, especially at dusk and dawn. Oh
